## History

Irving was a former suitor of Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) who had a romantic quarrel with her years in the past. After his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) introduced the two again, Irving and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) reconciled and got married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Irving courts [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), taking walks in the woods with her. Their connection traces back to a long-ago romance and quarrel between [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Though they are rumored or presumed to be spouses, their relationship in this period is defined by their courting and eventual wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), +10 more_

- Romantically involved with — courting and taking walks in the woods together  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
